primitives.name: Jump Failure Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: TRACK ATHLETICS 27 if on the third the jumper fails to clear the bar he drops out.
primitives.assumptions: Each trial has binary success/failure outcome; third failure terminates event.

layer2.mapping: Failure threshold maps to discrete stochastic process with absorbing state at T=3.
layer2.telemetry: Number of failed attempts before drop-out.

primitives.name: Balk Rule Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: To run under the bar is a balk, and three of these successive balks constitute a trial jump.

layer2.mapping: Balk accumulation defines a bounded counter within jump execution kernel.

primitives.name: Fair Jump Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: A fair jump is one made without the assistance of weights, diving, somersaults, or handsprings of any kind.

layer2.mapping: Fairness condition enforces constraint on motion space; excludes non-linear kinematics.

primitives.name: Pole Vault Kinematics
primitives.verbatim_quote: As the pole is reaching the perpendicular he swings himself over the bar, letting go the pole at the same moment.
primitives.assumptions: Pole swing modeled as rotational motion about pivot point.

layer2.mapping: Rotational dynamics of pole vaulting mapped to angular momentum conservation.
layer2.telemetry: Angular position and release timing during vault.
